treatments_received.treatment: Attendance at A&E (North District Hospital) with analgesic treatment and x-rays
source: (a) Matthew was attended by Dr Li Chun Kwong at 1635 hours on 16 April 2013;
(e) x-ray of nasal bone, pelvic and right thigh did not reveal any bone fracture;

treatments_received.treatment: CT scan / medical imaging (Union Hospital) showing chip fracture of nasal bone
source: (a) Chip fracture of the inferior tip of the nasal bone right to midline is detected;
(b) no significant deviation of nasal septum is noted; and
(c) no vault fracture or pneumocephaly is evident. Mild degree of mucosal thickening is seen lining bilateral ethmoidal and maxillary sinuses.

treatments_received.treatment: Follow-up consultations and observation at Union Hospital and specialist reports (Orthopaedics and ENT); no further treatment required
